name: Adoption effort
scoped_purpose: Steps and files needed for a newcomer, following only the standard, to add a passing solution or a passing new repository.
record: The steps and files a newcomer needs, following only the standard, to add a passing solution or a passing new repository, noted per trial.
gap: apply-esoi: No recorded trial compares the adoption effort of the two implementations, so the choice rests on principle 4, not on a measurement. the-standard: No newcomer trial of following only the standard has been recorded.
action: apply-esoi: Have a newcomer apply ESOI to a fresh repository once documents only and once with the tools, and record each as a run of metric-adoption-effort; review this by 2026-12-31. the-standard: Have a newcomer follow only the standard in a fresh repository and record the effort as a run of metric-adoption-effort; review by 2026-12-31.

name: Record completeness
scoped_purpose: Share of records with every template field filled and every link resolving both ways.
record: The share of records with every template field filled and linked both ways, counted by the records cases and noted per review.

name: Template agreement
scoped_purpose: Whether the registry's fields equal the skill template's fields, and the count of required fields left empty after a refinement.
record: Whether the committed field list equals the parsed template, and the number of required fields left empty after a refinement, per run of the template check.

name: Trace completeness
scoped_purpose: Share of files that reach a problem and an ideal through a component and a solution.
record: The share of files that reach a problem and an ideal, counted by the ownership cases and noted per review.

name: Resolution correctness
scoped_purpose: Share of selection cases (name, override, default, typo, every listed implementation) that resolve as specified.
record: The share of selection cases that resolve as specified, per run of the selection cases.
gap: No run measures this solution itself: its chosen implementation is measured through runtime-selection in the esoi-runtime intent, and its rival (entry-point plugins) is not built or recorded.
action: Build the entry-point rival and record a run of both on the selection cases, or drop the rival from the alternatives; review by 2026-12-31.

name: Provenance completeness
scoped_purpose: Share of latest results with a clean commit, a case hash, cost and tokens, run through shipped code.
record: The share of latest results with a clean commit, a case hash, cost and tokens, per run of the provenance cases.

name: Ranking correctness
scoped_purpose: Share of pinned result sets where the leaderboard's verdict matches the known right verdict, including ties and different case sets.
record: The share of pinned result sets where the leaderboard's verdict matches the known right verdict, per run of the ranking cases.

name: Case discrimination
scoped_purpose: Share of invariant solutions whose naive baselines all fail the cases.
record: The share of invariant solutions whose naive baselines all fail the cases, counted by the proof that each baseline fails.
gap: No run reports how many invariant solutions have a naive baseline that fails their cases; one test proves each baseline individually.
action: Record the share over the invariant solutions as a run of metric-case-discrimination; review by 2026-12-31.

name: Check dependability
scoped_purpose: Whether a clean tree is never flagged, an exception that no longer applies is reported, and how long the check takes.
record: Per run of the mutation cases: whether a clean tree is flagged, whether an unused exception is reported, and the check's run time.

name: Violation detection
scoped_purpose: Share of injected violations reported by the right rule and path.
record: The share of injected violations reported by the right rule and path, per run of the mutation cases.
gap: The mistake behind each rule, and what it has caught since, are not recorded per rule: the reason lives in the author's head and the ids say nothing.
action: Add a record per rule (id, plain name, statement, the mistake, the solution it serves) and have the check keep the records in step with the rules the code declares; review by 2026-12-31.

name: Review coverage
scoped_purpose: Share of records and verdicts present in the sheet, and share of reviewer edits that survive a rebuild and reach the repository.
record: The share of records and verdicts present in the sheet, and the share of reviewer edits that survive a rebuild and reach the repository, per sync.

name: Consumer soundness
scoped_purpose: Unmapped integration points, consumer stores not scored by the library's cases, and commits of pin lag.
record: The unmapped integration points, the consumer stores not scored by the library's cases, and the commits of pin lag, per consumer check.

name: Structure cost against catches
scoped_purpose: Time and files the structure adds per change, against real violations it caught.
record: The time and files the structure adds per change, against the real violations it caught, noted per period.
gap: No run measures the structure's cost against the violations it catches; the written weighing rule is applied by people.
action: Record the time the check adds and the real violations it caught over a month, and decide whether a coded implementation pays; review by 2026-12-31.

name: Decisions backed by current results
scoped_purpose: Measures the share of selection decisions that cited a current result, and the spend per decision.
record: Per run of the staleness cases: cases passed out of cases run (a stale or missing result is reported and a current one is not), one row per run in the results log; per decision: whether the cited result was current when chosen and what the runs behind it cost, noted in the decision's record.

name: Skill copy agreement and leaks
scoped_purpose: Whether the public copy equals what the source generates, and how many private terms, paths or emails it holds.
record: Per run of the skill check: whether each copy equals the generated one, and the count of leaks found, with the cases that plant each kind of leak.

name: Behaviour adherence
scoped_purpose: Share of cases where an agent's reply acts by the principle the case tests, per principle, for each way of giving the agent the principles and for an agent without them.
record: Per run: cases passed out of cases run for each principle and each implementation, with restraint and kept-qualifier cases counted apart, on a stated sample and model.
gap: The metric is carried out by behave-by-esoi, whose arms that call a model have no recorded run yet, so the ways of giving an agent the principles are not ranked.
action: On Joshua's approval, run the staged sample of the model arms under the metric run policy and let the leaderboard rank them; review by 2026-12-31.

name: Steps followed
scoped_purpose: Measures how well a stated order lets a person or an agent apply ESOI to real work without help.
record: Per trial: the implementation of the order used, the work it was applied to, steps completed, skipped with a reason and skipped silently, questions about what to do next, and whether the result passes the structure check with a checked metric.
gap: No trial of a person or an agent following the steps is recorded, so the steps are not compared with the other orders.
action: Have a newcomer and an agent each follow the steps on real work and record each trial as a run of metric-steps-followed; review by 2026-12-31.

name: Newcomer effort
scoped_purpose: Measures how many steps and files a newcomer needs to reach a passing check from the documentation alone.
record: Not recorded by a run yet; noted per trial by hand.
gap: No recorded run measures how a newcomer fares with the documentation.
action: Have a newcomer follow the guides in a fresh repository and record the effort as a run.

name: Steps trial
scoped_purpose: Measures, per trial, how far someone gets through the steps without help.
record: Not recorded by a run yet; noted per trial by hand as metric-steps-followed describes.
gap: No trial of a person or an agent following the steps has been recorded.
action: Have a newcomer and an agent each follow the steps on a real piece of work and record the trial as metric-steps-followed describes.

name: Local index lookup cases
scoped_purpose: Measures whether a lookup finds the project, its first file and its relations for a world of projects the guidance never named.
record: Cases passed out of cases run for each implementation on the same cases, one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash.
command: esoi run index_projects --impl live_index; esoi run index_projects --impl skill_rows; esoi run index_projects --impl records_only

name: Judge agreement
scoped_purpose: Agreement of a judge's verdicts with labelled replies, with false passes and false fails counted apart and the share of labels that are a person's.
record: Per run: replies graded the same as their label out of replies graded, with false passes, false fails and labels from a person.
gap: No reply has a person's label yet, so the judge's agreement with people is unmeasured.
action: Have a person label a sample of recorded replies, then record the judge's agreement as a run of metric-esoi-judge-agreement; review by 2026-12-31.

name: ESOI behaviour cases
scoped_purpose: Measures whether an agent's reply acts by the principle each case tests, for each way of giving the agent the principles.
record: Cases passed out of cases run for each arm on the same cases and sample, one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash; the headline lists passes per principle.
gap: The arms that call a model are not measured yet, so nothing shows how much the skill changes behaviour or which way of giving it is best.
action: Run the staged sample for each arm once Joshua approves the spend, then adopt the measured winner or declare a tie.

name: ESOI judge agreement cases
scoped_purpose: Measures how often a judge's verdict equals the label of the recorded reply it graded, with false passes and false fails apart.
record: Replies graded as labelled out of replies graded for each judge on the same cases and sample, one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash; the headline lists both error kinds and the labels that are a person's.
gap: The model judge is not measured yet and every label is still the case author's, so agreement cannot show calibration against a person.
action: Have a person fill human_verdict for a sample of replies, then run the judge on a staged sample once Joshua approves the spend.

name: Declaration sync
scoped_purpose: Measures whether what the code declares reaches the records, and whether a person's text survives.
record: Cases passed out of cases run for each implementation on the same cases, one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash.

name: README fidelity
scoped_purpose: Measures whether the generated page equals what the records say and is reported when it does not.
record: Cases passed out of cases run for each implementation on the same cases, one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash.

name: Promotion correctness
scoped_purpose: Measures whether a clear winner is promoted only on current, comparable, verified results and only where the policy allows it.
record: Cases passed out of cases run for each implementation on the same cases, one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash.

name: Specification recall at k
scoped_purpose: Measures whether the records a request concerns are among the first few returned for labelled requests, and what share of the records' size the tier-0 scan costs.
record: Cases passed out of cases run for each implementation on the same cases (a case passes when every expected record is in the top k, or the scan stays under its size ceiling), one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash.
command: esoi run spec_index --impl weighted_tfidf; esoi run spec_index --impl term_overlap

name: Python selector cases
scoped_purpose: Measures whether the python selector does what its solution defines.
record: Cases passed out of cases run for each implementation on the same cases, one row per run in the results log pinned to the commit and the case hash.
